summary.date_acceptance: At least 50% of historical WorldCover-built thermal support passes strict quality filters; cutoff defined before inspecting thermal results. Requires two accepted dates. Historical urban support is an incomplete proxy for current city extent.
summary.validation_status: Consistency and visual quality audit only; no independent ground-truth accuracy assessment.
summary.strict_mask: Clear land in all 3 Sentinel dates; exclude union of SCL water, Landsat QA water and spectral water candidates; also exclude historical WorldCover 2021 water, herbaceous wetland and mangrove classes; add 60m exclusion buffer and remove crop-border halo; >=90% inland optical footprint; ST_QA<=2K; cloud distance>=1km; cloud/shadow/fill/snow/water/saturation excluded.
summary.spectral_water_rule: MNDWI >0.20 and NDVI <0.10, illustrative uncalibrated flag, SWIR native20m resampled to10m.
summary.cell_threshold: At least 25 common delivered30m samples per cell (>=0.0225km2); thermal native100m, samples spatially dependent.

dates.thermal_comparison_status: excluded: fewer than 50% of historical urban inland samples pass filters

summary.sensitivity_scope: All 3 thermal dates required; primary comparison uses the dates passing the baseline quality filters.
summary.interpretation: Only 3 September morning scenes; optical matches within 1 day for first2. Seasonal trends, causal cooling, ground-truth temperature and health risk are not established. Different weather, sensor, emissivity and masking affect values.

attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2026). Landsat imagery courtesy of USGS.

planning.scope: Exploratory shortlist for site investigation; not a heat-health risk model or intervention prescription.
planning.score: 0.50 heat percentile + 0.30 inverse green-pixel percentile + 0.20 mapped-building percentile; 0-100 relative only within this pilot.

study.boundary_status: Analyst-defined city study window; not an official administrative boundary. Includes surrounding desert and coastal context.
study.urban_candidate_rule: At least 10% historical WorldCover 2021 built-up OR at least 2% mapped OSM building coverage within retained clear-land support of a 300m cell. Screening is incomplete and requires review.

planning.urban_candidate_screen: At least 10% historical WorldCover 2021 built-up OR at least 2% mapped OSM building coverage within retained clear-land support of a 300m cell. Screening is incomplete and requires review.
planning.osm_scope: Closed tagged ways only, center-pixel rasterisation; multipolygon relations and unmapped buildings may be missed. Not total building density or paved area.
planning.validation_limit: OSM positive polygon checks are independent contributed reference checks for optical rules, not a representative accuracy assessment or field truth. WorldCover uses some OSM auxiliary inputs, so building agreement is not independent model validation. Reference ages vary; human confirmations pending.

planning.worldcover_scope: 2021 historical CatBoost-derived land cover, not current segmentation. Class 50 merges buildings, roads and structures.
planning.unresolved: No independent thermal calibration, air temperature, population, shade, heat-health validation or causal cooling estimate.
